title: Sculpture
comment: A field you can hold in your hand: every value a height; render sculpture
writes an STL, a solid to print (the objects shown are the files alea wrote,
rendered by stl-view.py: run 11-sculpture.sh first); relief and base, in
millimetres; with time in the field, at picks the moment: three objects.
draws: let hf(u, v, w) = sin(u * 30 + sin(v * 9) * 2 - w * 6)

sections.name: the hook
sections.label: sculpture
sections.say: A field you can hold in your hand.
stage: let hk1 = text("11  ·  sculpture", x: 0.5, y: 0.74, size: 0.036, font: "mono") * (T >= 3.3)
let hk2 = text("alea, one feature at a time", x: 0.5, y: 0.81, size: 0.03, font: "mono") * (T >= 3.3)
let hookf = max(wave * RED, max(hk1 * INK, hk2 * GREY))

sections.name: every value a height
sections.label: height
sections.say: Every value is a height: white is high, black is low.
stage: let g2 = text("white: high  ·  black: low", x: 0.5, y: 1.14, size: 0.026, font: "mono") * (T >= 11.5)
let s2f = max(k2_code, max(fr2 * RULE, g2 * GREY))

sections.name: render sculpture: a file to print
sections.label: an object
sections.say: Render sculpture: an STL file, a solid you can print.
stage: let s3f = max(k3_code, max(fr3 * RULE, g3 * GREY))

sections.name: relief and base, in millimetres
sections.label: relief, base
sections.say: Relief sets how tall it stands; base, how thick its floor.
stage: let g4 = merge(text("cut at y = 0.5  ·  100 mm", x: 0.5, y: 1.14, size: 0.026, font: "mono") * (T >= 25.7), text("relief 25 mm  ·  base 4 mm", x: 0.5, y: 0.66, size: 0.026, font: "mono") * (T >= 25.7) * (mo < 0.5), text("relief 10 mm  ·  base 10 mm", x: 0.5, y: 0.66, size: 0.026, font: "mono") * (mo >= 0.5))
let s4f = max(k4_code, max(max(fr4 * RULE, cut * ((y > floor4) * FN + (y <= floor4) * GREY)), max(edge4 * INK, g4 * GREY)))

sections.name: at: three moments, three objects
sections.label: at
sections.say: Put time in it, and at picks the moment: three moments, three objects.
stage: let s5f = max(k5_code, max(fr5 * RULE, g5 * GREY))

sections.name: the end
sections.say: Next week: components. Works inside works.
stage: let name2 = text("alea", x: nx0e, y: 0.64, size: nsize, font: "mono", align: "left") * (T >= 43.8)
let ecur = (abs(x - (nx0e + 4.5 * nadv)) < nadv * 0.42) * (abs(y - 0.64) < nsize * 0.4) * blink * (T >= 43.8)
let e1 = text("one feature at a time  ·  11  ·  sculpture", x: 0.5, y: 0.78, size: 0.03, font: "mono") * (T >= 44.3)
let e2 = text("alea.bngz.io", x: 0.5, y: 0.89, size: 0.06, font: "mono") * (T >= 44.8)
let e3 = text("next  ·  12  ·  components", x: 0.5, y: 1.02, size: 0.03, font: "mono") * (T >= l6.words[2])
let e4 = text("open source  ·  github.com/sudo-bngz/alea", x: 0.5, y: 1.1, size: 0.026, font: "mono") * (T >= 45.8)
let endf = max(k6_code, max(name2 * INK, max(ecur * RED, max(e1 * INK, max(e2 * RED, max(e3 * GREY, e4 * INK))))))
